text:
Total consideration per share is $115.00 in cash (net to seller) plus one CVR per share, i.e., the Offer Price equals Closing Amount plus one CVR.
Closing Amount: $115.00 per share in cash; CVR: one (1) CVR per share; Merger Consideration per Share: Closing Amount in cash plus 1 CVR; Stock exchange ratio: Purchaser’s outstanding Shares convert 1-for-1 into shares of the Surviving Corporation; Company Options: cash payment equal to the excess of Closing Amount over the option’s exercise price per Share times the number of Shares subject to the option, plus 1 CVR per Share; Company RSUs: cash payment equal to Closing Amount times the number of Shares subject to such RSU, plus 1 CVR per Share; Milestone Payment: entitlement via the CVR Agreement (Milestone Payment) notwithstanding.
Not a fixed stock-for-stock exchange ratio; for each Company Share, the holder receives the Merger Consideration consisting of the Closing Amount in cash (subject to withholding taxes) plus one CVR, while Purchaser Shares convert 1-for-1 into Surviving Corporation stock. The Merger Consideration shall be appropriately adjusted if the outstanding Shares are changed by stock splits or similar transactions (Section 2.05(b)).
